# react-data-form

> React library for data-driven forms: a form is described as an object, and
> the library renders the fields, holds the state, validates, and reports the
> errors an API sends back. Built for JSON-LD / API Platform backends, but
> usable with any of them.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://cardona.digital/react-data-form/): what react-data-form is, installation, and where to go next
- [Field controllers](https://cardona.digital/react-data-form/?page=controllers): every built-in input controller, running live
- [Building a form](https://cardona.digital/react-data-form/?page=forms): fields, groups, steps and submission
- [Asymmetric forms](https://cardona.digital/react-data-form/?page=multi-forms): one array field whose entries take different shapes
- [Validation & errors](https://cardona.digital/react-data-form/?page=validation): per-field rules and reporting API violations

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/SalvadorCardona/react-data-form): source code, README and changelog
